name: programs-grid
description: Multi-card horizontal grid showcasing Tracy Harris Co's programs. Home page anchor section. Each card summarises one program with a CTA.
intent: Make the visitor understand the pathway in 30 seconds: three programs, one direction, room for all starting points. Earn the click to the right program detail page.
whenToUse: Homepage (Tracy parent brand) as the primary offer block. Program detail pages as a cross-link to sister programs. Not for funnel pages where you want a single CTA.

header.title: Section title, serif, italic emphasis on key phrase

cards.description: Array of program cards. 2-4 cards works; 3 is the default.

fields.accent: sage | gold | green | navy — the brand accent colour for the card
fields.title: Program name with italic emphasis on differentiator word
fields.tagline: Short italic line beneath title (3-5 words)

variants.twoUp: 2 cards. Used on product pages showing sister programs.
variants.fourUp: 4 cards, tighter. Used if we add SMS back or similar.

tracy.title: Three programs. One pathway.
tracy.sub: Start where you are, choose the path that fits, build something that lets you live.

avoid: Cards with wildly different content lengths. Keep descriptions to similar line counts.
Generic icons on each card. Typography + accent colour carries the distinction.
Bright competing CTAs. Each card has one link, same visual weight, differentiated only by destination.

a11y.heading: Section <h2>, cards as <article> with internal <h3>
a11y.linkText: Each CTA should include the program name so screen readers get context (not 'Learn more')
a11y.contrast: Accent colours used only as thin decorative lines, never as type-background combinations that would fail contrast
